card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sign off your evacuation plan, these arrows need the approved red.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone found the exit during the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We'll discuss that after the arrows match the sample.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sample faded in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a replacement sample before we can establish what everyone successfully followed.
